title: Landing Error Scoring System
note: Generated by tools/positions.py --extract from the page itself. Edit the verification, kind, signed_off_by and note fields; everything else is rewritten on the next extraction. The detector over collects on purpose: mark anything that is teaching rather than clinical direction as NOT_CLINICAL rather than deleting it.

positions.as_written: Set up a standardised jump, which is a drop and a forward jump to a marked landing area.
Ask the patient to jump and land naturally, without coaching, because coaching changes what is being measured.
Repeat enough trials for a representative score rather than scoring one landing.
